canonical_steps.action: Navigate to e& UAE portal homepage
canonical_steps.expected_result: e& UAE portal homepage loads with active navigation header

canonical_steps.action: Dismiss cookie and privacy overlay banner
canonical_steps.expected_result: Privacy overlay is dismissed cleanly

canonical_steps.action: Navigate to Accessories -> Earbuds catalog
canonical_steps.expected_result: Earbuds catalog displays available products and pricing

canonical_steps.action: Open product configuration for {{product_name}}

canonical_steps.action: Select One Time payment option
canonical_steps.expected_result: One time payment option is activated

canonical_steps.action: Verify Shopping Cart & Secure Checkout review screen
canonical_steps.expected_result: Order summary is displayed with proceed to checkout options
